baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restriction in مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً and the overlap in تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Waiting or deferral is compressed into one frightening acoustic onset; its seizure coincides with reciprocal dispute, leaving no interval in which anticipation becomes preparation.

activation_trace.role: Waiting for a time or receiving delay supplies the expectant posture that the event defeats.
A frightening cry supplies the sudden acoustic onset and its immediately harmful force.
Numerical oneness removes any sequence of warnings or recoverable stages.
Taking as possession makes the event actively seize rather than merely surprise them.
Reciprocal contention supplies the unfinished activity inside which the seizure lands.

changed_reading.before: They passively wait for a future blast that will eventually interrupt them.
changed_reading.after: Their waiting affords no usable warning: one acoustic onset takes possession of them inside an unfinished dispute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of صَيْحَةً, تَأْخُذُهُمْ, and يَخِصِّمُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The loud cry can function as an arresting summons: parties engaged in contention become apprehended respondents whose liability overtakes their argument.

activation_trace.role: The high voice gives the seizure a public, summons-like acoustic form.
Being taken to account for an offense supplies liability rather than neutral capture.
Arrest and captivity turn liability into an enforced change of status.
The disputants supply the parties upon whom the arresting sound acts.

changed_reading.before: A calamity happens to interrupt people who happen to be arguing.
changed_reading.after: An audible arrest takes contentious parties as liable respondents, so interruption and accountability coincide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reciprocal contest in يَخِصِّمُونَ is immediately subordinated to تَأْخُذُهُمْ and وَاحِدَةً.
baseline_models.mechanism: A distributed contest in which people try to prevail over one another is gathered under one superior grip; reciprocal agency is reversed into common passivity.

activation_trace.role: Mutual contention supplies many competing centers of agency.
The wrestling hold supplies a bodily image for an event that overmasters every contestant at once.
Union in one direction compresses competing parties into one imposed outcome.

changed_reading.before: The quarrel and the catastrophe are merely simultaneous.
changed_reading.after: Their many attempts to master one another are themselves mastered and gathered by one superior seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice presents the word as becoming due; the focus cry then reads as enforcement of an already accrued claim rather than the beginning of liability.

activation_trace.role: Taking to account anchors the focus seizure in liability.
A fixed and deserved obligation supplies liability already due before the focus event.
The repeated fixing of what is due confirms that the consequence is accrued, not improvised.

structural_cues: The construction حق القول appears at 36:7 and again at 36:70 around warning and unbelief.
The focus seizure stands between those two statements of a consequence becoming due.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a word becoming due and a focus seizure; I infer that the cry enforces accrued liability. A live alternative is that the repeated construction marks only certainty, without a forensic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The cry initiates a sudden punishment.
changed_reading.after: The cry executes a consequence that has already become binding, taking the disputants at the point of enforcement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visual apprehension is first blocked and later actively refused; the focus shifts the unavoidable encounter into sound, so the cry bypasses the channel through which signs were not received.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight makes visual apprehension a live undertone in their waiting.
The high voice supplies an auditory event that does not depend on their visual attention.
Literal eyesight supplies the failed perceptual channel explicitly denied in the verse.
Repeated visible signs supply perceivable warnings available before the terminal sound.
Turning one's side away makes the failure to receive signs active rather than merely sensory.

structural_cues: 36:9 ends with فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ.
36:46 repeats the arrival of signs and their turning away immediately before the challenge and focus event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sight, refused signs, and then a seizing cry; I infer a visual-to-auditory bypass. A live alternative is that يَنظُرُونَ means waiting only and carries no visual undertone here.

changed_reading.before: They simply wait for an event whose mode is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Those who do not receive visible signs are forced into an auditory encounter that seizes them without requiring their attention or assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written deeds and surviving traces are exhaustively counted, recompense answers action, and sealed mouths yield to knowledgeable witness; the cry transfers disputants from self-authored argument into an evidence regime they do not control.

activation_trace.role: Taking to account anchors the transfer in answerability.
Contention supplies the self-controlled verbal mode that will be displaced.
A written fixing that establishes judgment supplies a record independent of present argument.
A remaining mark supplies durable evidence of what has passed.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration makes the record resistant to omission.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the decision rule applied to the record.
A preventing seal removes the disputants' control of oral presentation.
Knowledgeable testimony replaces adversarial assertion with disclosure.

structural_cues: 36:12 writes what was sent ahead and the traces left behind, then enumerates everything.
36:54 ties recompense to what they were doing.
36:65 seals mouths while hands speak and feet testify.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete record, action-matched recompense, sealed mouths, and bodily testimony; I infer that the seizure transfers them from oral contention to externally controlled evidence. A live alternative is that these are successive images of judgment without a courtroom-like transfer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Death merely cuts off an argument.
changed_reading.after: The cry removes the disputants from a contest of claims and places them under records and witnesses that continue speaking after their own mouths lose control.

context_deltas.mechanism: People repeatedly take deities as acquired protections, but those acquisitions cannot extract or help them; the focus reverses subject and object as the takers are themselves captured and later brought into presence.

activation_trace.role: Capture and arrest make the former agents into seized objects.
Acquiring something for oneself supplies the first attempted act of protective possession.
Extraction from another's grip supplies the rescue that the acquired objects cannot perform.
The repeated acquisition of deities turns the earlier hypothetical act into a collective practice.
Expected aid supplies the protective function sought from what they took.
Capacity and ability, explicitly absent, explain why the protective acquisition cannot reverse the seizure.
Compelled presence extends capture into being brought along with the failed protectors.

structural_cues: 36:23 poses taking deities together with their inability to rescue.
36:74-75 repeats taking deities for aid, denies their capacity, and ends in compelled presence.
In 36:49 the grammatical subject of taking is no longer the people but the single cry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated human acquisition, failed rescue, and then an event that takes the acquirers; I infer a deliberate agency reversal. A live alternative is that the change from اتخذ to أخذ is only lexical recurrence and not a designed subject-object reversal.

changed_reading.before: The cry simply captures people who lack protection.
changed_reading.after: Those who tried to secure reality by taking protectors become the objects taken, while their acquisitions cannot pull them from the seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact one-cry formula has already produced an immediate fall from activity into stillness; that local prototype gives the focus seizure the mechanics of a one-stroke shutdown.

activation_trace.role: The frightening cry anchors the focus event in the repeated formula.
Numerical singleness makes shutdown a single transition rather than a process.
The earlier frightening cry supplies an exact acoustic prototype for the focus event.
The repeated numerical one confirms that no cumulative sequence is needed.
Life or awareness becoming still after motion supplies the result-state of the cry.

structural_cues: 36:29 and 36:49 share the full صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً formula.
The earlier formula moves directly to فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact formula followed by immediate stillness and repeats it at the focus; I infer shared one-stroke shutdown mechanics. A live alternative is that 36:29 is only a historical analogy and need not specify the later event's result.

changed_reading.before: The single cry is mainly an alarming signal.
changed_reading.after: The single cry is itself a threshold event that collapses active disputation into stillness in one stroke.

context_deltas.mechanism: Merciful preservation is explicitly extended only to a time; the challengers try to convert that horizon into a scheduled promise, but the cry closes it before they can transmit a final charge or return to their kin.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and granted delay anchor the tension between respite and expiry.
The event's taking closes the temporary interval by removing those who occupied it.
Extended preservation for enjoyment supplies respite as a maintained interval, not immunity.
A thing's appointed time supplies the boundary built into that respite.
A promise delimited by time or place supplies the schedule the challengers demand.
Lost capacity makes the interruption operational rather than merely emotional.
A charge connected onward to another supplies the future-directed speech they cannot complete.
The group of kin and belonging supplies the social continuity abruptly made unreachable.
Return to a prior place or state supplies the denied route back into ordinary continuity.

structural_cues: 36:44 defines preservation as enjoyment إلى حين.
36:48 asks when the promise will occur.
36:49-50 moves from active dispute to inability to make a charge or return home.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporary preservation, a demanded appointment, seizure, and immediate loss of bequest and return; I infer that the cry is the expiry mechanism of respite. A live alternative is that the respite at 36:44 concerns a different danger and only loosely orients the focus timing.

changed_reading.before: They wait for a date while ordinary life continues until an externally chosen interruption.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit a bounded extension they mistake for control; its expiry takes them before speech, inheritance, and kinship can carry the present forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence stages a dispute over releasing assigned provision and feeding another, turns that refusal into a challenge about the promised time, and then seizes the speakers while contention is still active.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal contention anchors the immediate social argument in the focus clause.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies the demanded circulation that triggers resistance.
An apportioned gift frames the resource as assigned provision rather than absolute possession.
Feeding another supplies the concrete social obligation being argued away.
The demanded appointment moves the dispute from provision to control over the threatened horizon.

structural_cues: 36:47 is a voiced exchange over spending and feeding.
36:48 continues with a spoken challenge about the promise.
36:49 says the cry takes them while they are still contending.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a live provision argument, a temporal challenge, and the focus participial circumstance; I infer that يَخِصِّمُونَ can retain that immediate moral-economic dispute. A live alternative is that it depicts unrelated everyday quarrels or transactions at the moment of seizure.

changed_reading.before: They are taken during an unspecified quarrel.
changed_reading.after: They are taken while actively converting assigned provision and another's hunger into a theological excuse, before that refusal can be resolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later exact one-cry formula does not end in stillness but in universal gathering, compelled presence, and recompense; this activates a competing reading of the focus cry as transport into assembly and judgment.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the enforced transfer out of the disputants' current scene.
The high voice anchors the event in the repeated summons-like sound.
One in number makes a single sound sufficient for universal transfer.
The repeated high voice supplies the acoustic means immediately preceding assembly.
The repeated numerical one binds the gathering result to the same compact event-form.
Joining the dispersed into a gathered whole supplies the event's spatial-social result.
Presence and nearness turn gathering into compelled appearance before an authority.
Action-matched recompense supplies the purpose of the compelled assembly.

structural_cues: 36:53 repeats صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً exactly.
Its immediate result is that all are gathered and present, followed at 36:54 by recompense.
This outcome competes with, rather than erases, the extinguishing outcome activated by 36:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact one-cry formula followed by universal presence and recompense; I infer that the focus taking can be forced transport into judgment. A live alternative is that 36:49 and 36:53 describe distinct cries whose mechanics should not be transferred to one another.

changed_reading.before: The cry takes them only by destroying or immobilizing them.
changed_reading.after: The cry can take them as a mustering summons, removing disputants from scattered contention and producing one compelled assembly for recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same contention root later names the human made from a drop as an overt adversary who advances an example while neglecting his own creation; the focus dispute therefore expands from interpersonal friction into created agency contesting re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual contention anchors the plural focus activity that the later singular adversary sharpens.
Clear fluid extending to semen supplies the materially slight origin of the adversarial speaker.
The same contention branch explicitly turns the created human into an overt opponent.
Presenting and displaying an example supplies the opponent's argumentative act.
The formulated example supplies the argumentative object used against re-creation.
Leaving and neglecting something supplies the omitted premise of the speaker's own origin.
Creative origination supplies the fact neglected by the adversarial example.

structural_cues: 36:77 repeats خ ص م in the singular description خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ.
36:77-78 moves from creation out of a drop to an example against reviving decayed bones.
The focus catches a plural group in the same root activity before the surah exposes its culminating argument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated contention root, a materially slight origin, and an argument that neglects creation; I infer a thematic back-projection from the later adversary to the focus disputants. A live alternative is that the focus describes ordinary mutual disputes unrelated to the later resurrection argument.

changed_reading.before: The cry interrupts generic interpersonal contention.
changed_reading.after: The cry terminates a creaturely posture in which beings made from a drop turn their argumentative power against the possibility of being made again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ص ر خ and ص ي ح are distinct roots and 36:43 concerns rescue, not the focus event. It remains valid as a branch-backed reversal between an unanswered rescue-call and an incoming effective high voice, both anchored in the focus cry and taking. Downstream prose should call it a sonic or functional resonance, not an etymological identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The incoming صَيْحَةً is the effective agent of تَأْخُذُهُمْ.

activation_trace.role: The high voice supplies the incoming sound that acts successfully on the group.
A call for rescue supplies the outgoing voice for which no effective responder is available.
Rescue and answer supply the absent efficacy contrasted with the focus cry's total efficacy.
Extraction from danger supplies the deliverance explicitly unavailable to them.

changed_reading.before: One frightening noise arrives and no rescue follows.
changed_reading.after: Their outgoing emergency call cannot produce a rescuer, while one incoming cry alone possesses enough efficacy to take them all.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the lethal-gaze branch normally makes time look at a people, whereas the focus grammar makes the people wait. It remains anchored in ن ظ ر, the bounded حين, and the demanded موعد as an inversion of who controls the horizon. Downstream prose should present it as a branch-induced temporal image, never as the direct lexical gloss of يَنظُرُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The waiting verb يَنظُرُونَ stands before the single event that takes them.

activation_trace.role: Time's look that strikes a people with destruction supplies the inverted image of a horizon acting on its watchers.
Waiting for a time keeps the image attached to the actual verbal posture.
The appointed time of a thing supplies the bounded horizon within which they wait.
A promise bounded by time supplies their attempt to make that horizon inspectable and controllable.

changed_reading.before: They stand outside the event and watch for its scheduled arrival.
changed_reading.after: While they imagine themselves inspecting the horizon, the bounded time can be pictured as already bearing down on and fatally regarding them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 36:82 does not identify the focus cry with the command كن. It remains valid as an analogical activation anchored in the focus's single high voice and the packet's command-speech-to-occurrence mechanism. Downstream prose should say the cry behaves like efficacious utterance, not claim that the two expressions are identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One صَيْحَةً does not merely accompany but grammatically performs the taking.

activation_trace.role: The high voice supplies the utterance-like medium of the focus event.
One in number makes a single vocal act sufficient for the state change.
An obligating command supplies speech whose force is directive rather than descriptive.
Producing speech by utterance supplies the stated means of command.
Occurrence and presence in time supply the immediate result generated by the utterance.

changed_reading.before: The cry signals that a separately caused seizure has begun.
changed_reading.after: The single cry can be carried as an efficacious vocal act whose sounding and whose production of the seized state are one operation.

strongest_changes: The exact one-cry formula supports two live outcomes that should remain distinct: one-stroke extinction at 36:29 and compelled assembly for recompense at 36:53-54.
The focus taking becomes both enforcement of an already due consequence and a reversal in which those who took protectors become the ones taken.
The focus dispute moves from generic quarrelling into a transfer from self-controlled claims to written traces, sealed mouths, and knowledgeable testimony.
Waiting becomes occupancy of a bounded respite whose expiry prevents bequest, return, and further social continuity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed exact formula recurrences, a subject-object reversal around ء خ ذ, and a sustained struggle over perception and speech: signs are not received, arguments proliferate, then one sound removes control of both movement and testimony.
remaining_uncertainties: The visual-to-auditory model depends on retaining a visual undertone in يَنظُرُونَ even though waiting is the strongest local branch.
يَخِصِّمُونَ may continue the immediate provision and promise dispute, or it may depict unrelated ordinary contention.
The lethal gaze and performative cry are contained analogies, not direct identifications, and the two repeated one-cry scenes may denote distinct events.
